method: single model-assisted literal-text review; reviewer read only anonymized query and fetched excerpt for each case, without IDs, source paths, labels, scores, or run status

cases.justification: The excerpt names evidence classes rather than explaining what confidence represents in Typed Claim IR.
It lists checks against the supplied snapshot, privacy class, revision, range and fingerprint, and says the exact range must be fully fetchable.
It describes exact-range retrieval and evidence-pack behavior but does not identify the Document Surface contract check governing materialization of the exact body for a source revision.

note: This is one model-assisted review, not owner-gold and not a statistical measurement.
